message: `window` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `readU16` panics when `[off, off + 2)` is outside `b`, and nothing proves it inside here: guard the call with `if (off >= 0 && off + 2 <= b.length)`
